description: European Central Bank euro reference rates (published once per working day around 16:00 CET): the rate for one currency against the euro, and an optional conversion of an amount between two of the listed currencies. Rates are the ECB's daily reference, not a live market quote; the list has about 30 currencies. Choose this tool for: European Central Bank euro reference rates: the rate. Close alternatives on this server: agent_intel_eu_vies_vat_batch_validator (Checks up to 5 EU VAT numbers with the European); agent_intel_iban_routing_swift_resolver (Validates an IBAN and, if it passes, looks up the bank). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
